shareHelp.title: What to share
shareHelp.intro: Your browser will now ask what to share. To record sound:
shareHelp.systemApp: Sound from a call or an app on this computer: choose Entire Screen and switch on Share system audio.
shareHelp.systemTab: Sound from a browser tab: choose that tab and keep its audio switch on.
shareHelp.tabOnly: Choose the browser tab that plays the sound and keep its audio switch on.
shareHelp.tabOnlyNote: On this computer the browser cannot record sound from other apps.
shareHelp.none: This browser cannot record sound from a shared screen or tab. Use Chrome or Edge, or record from the microphone.
shareHelp.noSwitch: Without the audio switch, no sound is recorded.
shareHelp.video: If Also record video is ticked, what you share is saved as video too.
shareHelp.guide: If no sound comes through, Speakr opens its full guide.
